# Michael Zhao

> AI engineer in Sydney, Australia. Builds agent platforms, tool systems, and eval systems for production use. Previously AI Engineer at Relevance AI (agent platform) and ML Engineer at SEEK. Open to engineering roles and collaboration.

## About

- [GitHub](https://github.com/myz96): Open-source work and code.

## Projects

- [MCP Arena](https://github.com/myz96/mcparena): Open-source MCP evaluation and optimisation system. Scores MCP servers on task success, correctness, latency, and cost using DSPy and GEPA against MCP-Bench.
- [Momento](https://github.com/myz96/momento): A camera and audio capture device. ESP32-S3 firmware, a companion app, and a cloud backend. In progress.
- [AI Equity Researcher](https://github.com/myz96/ai-bank-equity-researcher): An agent for first-pass equity research. It attributes metric movements to drivers and cites the evidence. In progress.
